description: A single Polymarket outcome's bid-side vs ask-side order-book depth ratio, summed within depth_band_pct (default 5.0%) of each side's own best quote. 0.5 = balanced, closer to 1.0 = bid-side depth dominant, closer to 0.0 = ask-side dominant. A descriptive statistic only - not a prediction of price direction. Accepts either a raw token_id or a market_slug (+ outcome) to resolve it automatically. Paid in USDC on Base.

depth_band_pct.description: How far into the book, as a percent of each side's own best quote, to sum depth. Defaults to 5.0.

market_slug.description: Exact Polymarket market slug, used to resolve token_id automatically.

outcome.description: "yes" (default) or "no" - which side to resolve when using market_slug.

token_id.description: The outcome's CLOB token_id / asset_id, if already known.

name: prediction.orderbook_imbalance_ratio
